svg.title: Spring Bean Lifecycle
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the 10 stages of a Spring bean's lifecycle from instantiation to destruction.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Spring bean instantiation in detail')
sendPrompt('What is dependency injection in Spring — setter vs constructor?')
g.text: Setter or constructor injection of dependencies

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the BeanNameAware interface do in Spring?')
g.text: setBeanName() called with the bean's ID
setBeanFactory() provides a reference to the factory

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is ApplicationContextAware and when should I use it?')
sendPrompt('What does @PostConstruct do and when is it called?')
sendPrompt('How do I define a custom init-method in Spring XML or @Bean?')
sendPrompt('How does postProcessAfterInitialization differ from the before version?')
sendPrompt('What does it mean for a Spring bean to be ready to use?')
sendPrompt('How do I configure a custom destroy-method?')
